_provenance.method: Parsed the saved get_metadata XML (text lives in node name= attributes) to enumerate every template, then read the rendered COPY (subject / preheader / hero / interstitial headline / body) from targeted get_screenshot renders of the web 'Gmail inbox template' (1024w, carries the subject line in the mock browser tab) and the mobile templates (Cakepop_txn_MB_NEW / Email template C / Teen_ChangePIN, 375w). Copy is verbatim from the rendered screenshots.
_provenance.board_layout_note: One board only. There is no separate 'parent' board to the right — the whole board is 53559px wide and organized left-to-right into category sections (Progress Tag labels): Debit card, Purchases, Direct deposit, P2P, Adding FI, Account status, Teen account security, Privacy, Downgrade. Each email exists as a WEB render (Gmail, ~1024w, on top) plus one or more MOBILE renders (~375w) of the same copy. Parent-facing vs teen-facing variants sit as separate mobile frames in the same column (e.g. Account status has a teen 'Your activity has been flagged' AND a parent 'Your Venmo accounts have been restricted'). Absolute-x note: metadata x for the board is -91793; positions below are relative node ids.

emails.template_name: Email template C (Account status / activity flagged – teen)
emails.subject: Your activity has been flagged
emails.preheader: You won’t be able to use your debit card.
emails.hero: Your access to the Venmo app and debit card have been restricted.
emails.body:
For help getting up and running again, ask your parent or guardian to contact us.

About account restriction:
• Flagging activity helps keep Venmo a safe place for all users.
• To protect the account and prevent fraud, we can only provide a limited amount of info about a restricted account without talking to the account owner.
• Security alerts are usually triggered by activity that goes against our User Agreement.
emails.notes: Teen-facing variant. Metadata also carries a parent-oriented line 'Add money to their account to get them up and running again.' present in this frame's node set (variant copy). Mobile sibling at 1260:50008.

emails.template_name: Email template C (Account status / accounts restricted – parent)
emails.subject: Your Venmo accounts have been restricted
emails.hero: Activity on your account for Lucas triggered an alert.
emails.body:
For security reasons, this account and any linked accounts have been been restricted. For help unlocking your accounts, give us a call.

About account restriction:
• Flagging activity helps keep Venmo a safe place for all users.
• To protect your account and prevent fraud, we can only provide a limited amount of information about a restricted account without talking to you.
• Security alerts are usually triggered by activity that goes against our User Agreement.
emails.notes: Parent-facing variant: addresses the adult about the teen ('your account for Lucas', 'any linked accounts', 'talking to you'). CTA 'Contact us'. Note 'been been restricted' is a typo present in the source copy (both teen and parent variants). No preheader text node found for this frame.

emails.subject: You have a new password
emails.preheader: If you just changed it, you’re all set.
emails.hero: Out with the old, in with new. If that’s what you said to your last password, then you’re good 🙌.
emails.body:
If this wasn’t you, do these two things:
• Reset your password: Head to the sign-in screen on your app and tap “Forgot your password?” or go to www.venmo.com.
• Tell your parent or guardian: They should give us a call so we can confirm your account is secure.

emails.template_name: Teen_ChangePIN (Teen account security / new login attempt)
emails.subject: New login attempt
emails.preheader: Trying to log in from a new device or browser?
emails.hero: If this was you, no worries.
emails.body:
But if it wasn’t, or you still need help logging in—read on.

Trouble logging in
New phone number? Didn’t receive a 6-digit code? Ask your parents or guardian to contact support. We can help!

This wasn’t me
If you didn’t try to sign-in from a new device, protect your account by resetting your password. Just tap “Forgot your password?” on the login screen.

Why am I getting this email?
For your security, we notify you every time there’s a unique sign-in to your Venmo account (including from your phone’s web browser or after you’ve cleared cookies).

emails.notes: CTA 'Go to Venmo'. Web sibling at 1260:51093.

emails.subject: Confirm your email Lucas
emails.preheader: Let’s get this Venmo party started 🥳
emails.body: Now all that’s left to do is verify your email address so we can let you know when you get paid.
emails.notes: CTA 'Confirm your email'. Onboarding/welcome email addressed to the teen (Lucas). Web sibling at 1260:50646. Preheader match 'Let’s get this Venmo party started' is the welcome-column preheader.
